title: Chemical peels
caption: A chemical peel is a controlled skin injury — an acid solution is applied to deliberately remove outer skin layers so the skin rebuilds itself smoother and more evenly. The depth of that injury (superficial, medium, or deep) is what changes recovery time, risk, and what the peel can actually address. Superficial peels refresh texture with minimal downtime; deeper peels reach further but need longer to heal. In the Gulf, skin-type and active sun exposure matter significantly in deciding which depth makes sense. Knowing the depth spectrum means you can ask the right question when someone recommends one. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
